summary: Per-bank Positive Pay settings (exception cutoff, notice sender domain, expected notice recipients) on banks.positive_pay_settings; NewFirst: 10:00 cutoff and the four recipients from go-live. Configuration only.

preflight.name: NewFirst National Bank is in the bank registry
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM banks WHERE id = '16e07b6a-8902-4d1a-980e-db78938b98b3' AND name = 'NewFirst National Bank'

preflight.name: the column does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'banks' AND column_name = 'positive_pay_settings'

expected_changes: banks: NewFirst National Bank's Positive Pay settings set (10:00 cutoff, newfirst.com, four expected recipients).

verify.name: NewFirst cutoff is 10:00
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM banks WHERE id = '16e07b6a-8902-4d1a-980e-db78938b98b3' AND positive_pay_settings->>'exception_cutoff' = '10:00'

verify.name: four expected recipients, Graywood not among them
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM banks, jsonb_array_elements_text(positive_pay_settings->'expected_recipients') r WHERE id = '16e07b6a-8902-4d1a-980e-db78938b98b3' AND r NOT ILIKE '%graywood%'

verify.name: only NewFirst is configured
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM banks WHERE positive_pay_settings IS NOT NULL
